literal_meaning: চার ভুজবিশিষ্ট বা চতুর্ভুজাকার (four-sided or quadrilateral)
figurative_meaning_en: clever and versatile; all-rounder; endowed with all qualities
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন চতুর্ভুজ ব্যক্তি, যিনি সব কাজেই পারদর্শী।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a quadrilateral person, proficient in every task.
note: The idiom draws from geometric terminology to metaphorically describe multifaceted abilities, common in literary Bengali expressions.
